senses.definition: n.pr.loc. capital city of king Bela in Edom Gn 36:32 = 1 Ch 1:43; identif. with Tennib (perhaps = Thenib, near the edge of the Belka, ENE. from Heshbon, described by Tristr Moab 222) by NeubauerAcad. 1891, 260 cf. Tomkinsib. 284.
